name: Drift algae mat
lore: Loose seaweed that piles up when the lagoon is left alone.
reference: Drift macroalgae mat on lagoon sand (Laurencia / Gracilaria tangles, as in Florida Bay and the Indian River Lagoon): a low, loose heap of round, wiry, much-branched stems, matted and dark olive-brown in the middle, rusty red-brown at the stem ends, smothering the sand

sway.personality: heavy, slow surge: the whole heap rocks a little with the current while loose stem ends lift and trail behind it

sit.why: a loose, soft heap settles onto whatever it lands on, so it should hug sand bumps rather than sit on them as a rigid lid
